principle: OBJECT CUSTODY IS A DISCRETE LATCH: body/object geometry may move continuously, but ownership changes only at authored grip and release events.

noodle_queen.contempt: Rejects tween sludge: connectors are permitted only inside unchanged contact/custody/support/root topology; causal joins hard-cut on authored keys.
noodle_queen.function: Contact ownership is readable at the anchor, support stays grounded through load/release, free-object lag occurs only after authored release, and recovery visibly pays the throw.
noodle_queen.taste: Specific custody-latch performance rather than generic object tweening; free, acquired, loaded, released, follow-through and recovery silhouettes are distinct.
noodle_queen.worth_attention: Demonstrates a reusable object-custody subrig that can be attached/detached without baking object ownership into the carrier pose.

tango.bounded_correction: Widened the abstract payload glyph; increased rear-foot counterlean at LOAD_MAX; extended throwing arm and torso lag at FOLLOW_THROUGH_LAG.
tango.first_visible_defect: Payload silhouette was too small and the load/follow-through did not carry enough visible leverage/cost.
tango.inspection: Rendered MP4 inspected as a sampled motion sheet after first compile, then revised and re-rendered.
tango.rerender_result: SILHOUETTE CLEAR; LOAD TRANSFER VISIBLE; CONTACT READABLE; FOLLOW THROUGH present; RECOVERY present; COST CARRIED. No material topology or floatiness defect remained.

rig.anchor_semantics: CUSTODY anchor is present only while A owns object; it is destroyed at RELEASE_FORK.
